note: Phase 11C: layer-sensitivity generalization research (does Phase 11B's single-model/single-context/5-prompt sensitivity ranking generalize across prompts, categories, models, and context sizes?). RESEARCH ONLY -- experiment/layer-sensitivity-generalization branch, built on experiment/mixed-q8-q5-layer-feasibility (Phase 11B), never merged, never a product CLI. All data from real membrane-kv-mixed-layer invocations on this host.

files.prompts.json: the 31-prompt set, category grouping, train/holdout split and its selection rule
files.raw_135m_ctx2048.jsonl: Stage A: 30-layer single-ablation sweep, SmolLM2-135M, ctx=2048, full 31 prompts
files.raw_360m_ctx2048.jsonl: Stage B: 32-layer single-ablation sweep, SmolLM2-360M, ctx=2048
files.raw_ctx8192.jsonl: Stage C: 30-layer single-ablation sweep, SmolLM2-135M, ctx=8192, 5-prompt pre-registered subset
files.raw_holdout_policy_135m.jsonl: raw per-config records behind holdout_policy.json (held-out prompt evaluation)
files.rankings.json: per-prompt and global rel_l2/delta_nll/top1 rankings PLUS rank-stability (Spearman/Kendall) for all three sweeps: 135m_ctx2048, 360m_ctx2048, 135m_ctx8192 -- one consolidated file, not three separate ones
files.category_rankings.json: per-category and task-group rankings + stable-sensitive-layer support frequencies, for both 135M and 360M (ctx=2048)
files.holdout_policy.json: train-derived ranking evaluated on held-out prompts, 5 non-endpoint layouts x 6 intermediate Q8-budgets plus the all-Q8/all-Q5 endpoints
files.pareto.json: held-out Pareto frontier (by top1 and by rel_l2, reported separately)
files.pressure_boundary.json: real GTX 1650 memory-pressure boundary test, 4 layer-selection strategies for 8/32 Q8 layers
files.performance.json: repeated-run throughput stability (5 CPU + 7 Vulkan runs)
files.summary.json: top-level findings summary, stable/unstable layers, decision-gate inputs
